Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step, the WebSurfer failed to distinguish between a movie and a television series. When searching for "Voice," the top results returned the popular Korean TV series "Voice" (2017–present) instead of the specific movie "Voice" (2016). The agent incorrectly identified the TV series as the target film and reported its genres (Action, Crime, Mystery) as the answer, missing the actual movie which belongs to the genres of Drama, Thriller, and Mystery.
